messages:
maria: FYI ran into onboarding friction — sample-app picked up REDWOOD_KEY (legacy) while SDK favored REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY. After rotating org token some tests failed and users were confused.

ben: can you repro? sounds like env precedence differs between SDKs/CLI.

maria: quick repro:
1) export REDWOOD_KEY=org_old
2) export REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY=proj_a
3) samples/start -> uses proj_a
4) redwoodctl whoami -> used org_old

kai: two asks: 1) standardize canonical precedence (project, org, legacy) across SDKs/CLI; 2) add onAuthFailure/onAuthRefresh hook so apps can prompt for new token instead of silent retries on 401.

sylvia: agree. add deprecation timeline for REDWOOD_KEY: warn for 3 releases, include migration snippet in warning. Also redact keys in logs (last 8 chars only).

ben: parity tests: unit tests for env-var order in py/js/go, integration test for rotation + hook invocation, CLI acceptance test for deprecation warning.

auth-bot: :information_source: Org token org_old rotated 2025-11-02T02:10:00Z. See internal/security/rotations.

maria: filing RFC with precedence table, hook API sketch, tests and deprecation plan. tagging @devex-owners for review.
